market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil at $108 and diesel at $6/gal drive cost-push inflation; Fed likely to signal hike or hold higher. Bond yields rising pressure equity multiples. Geopolitical headlines (Hormuz, Ukraine, Houthis) sustain risk premium. AI names show earnings strength but governance overhang limits upside. Consumer data softening. Expect 3-5% equity volatility over next 6-8 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive on AI infrastructure and energy transition, but constrained by rate environment and geopolitical fragmentation. AI capex cycle (Dell, Oracle, Nvidia) supports 12-18 month earnings growth. However, 'AI slowdown' calls and $760B systemic risk create correction risk. Energy transition (solar storage gap) offers structural opportunity. Consumer rotation to value persists. Multipolar capital flows (BRICS, Canada, Korea) reshape EM allocation. 6-12 month: expect choppy recovery with sector rotation favoring energy, AI infrastructure, value retail, and defense.
